name: io.github.slymnysr/sift
title: sift
description: Runs a command, keeps every byte on disk, returns only the lines that matter

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The server half is an extra. The command line alone has no dependencies, and somebody who wants it should not have to carry a protocol library for it.

packageArguments.description: Serve over stdio. The same server the sift-mcp command starts.

environmentVariables.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A free NVIDIA NIM key. Optional: without one every tool still runs the command, still keeps every byte, and still returns the exit code -- what is lost is the model's choice of lines, not the output. Also read from ~/.config/nvidia/api_key.
